Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 GTA Trailers GTA 6 Launch Trailer Available to Watch Right Now, Captured on PS5 Just gotta get through it by Stephen Tailby 7 hours ago Share: Rockstar Games has released the launch trailer for GTA 6 , giving us one more fresh look at the game ahead of its arrival. Watch it here: There's lots of new gameplay and cutscene footage included here, all captured on PS5. It seems Sony's marketing agreement runs deep with this game, as PlayStation branding is all over this video. GTA 6 just continues to look fantastic, with cinematic shots, mad action set-pieces, and the relationship between Jason and Lucia being the core focus. One new detail is that the music playing throughout the trailer is a brand new track made for the GTA 6 soundtrack. It's called Flower in a Hurricane , and it's by Justice — composers of the game's OST — featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard.
